items.originalTitle: 蒙托亚盛赞Madring赛道：2026赛季首条让他想重返驾驶舱的赛道
items.summaryEn: Former Formula 1 driver Juan Pablo Montoya has praised the brand-new Madring circuit, saying it is the first track of the 2026 season that has made him want to get back behind the wheel. After the Italian Grand Prix at Monza last weekend, where Mercedes finished 1-2 with Kimi Antonelli and George Russell, drivers now face a step into the unknown at the new 5.4km, 22-turn semi-street circuit in the Spanish capital.
detailZh: 胡安·巴勃罗·蒙托亚表示，马德里赛道是2026年F1赛历中第一条他想驾驶的赛道。
胡安·巴勃罗·蒙托亚对马德里赛道赛道给予好评，称其富有挑战性的布局让他想重新坐进驾驶舱。
前F1车手胡安·巴勃罗·蒙托亚对全新的马德里赛道赛道给予好评，透露这是2026赛季第一条让他想重新坐进驾驶舱的赛道。
上周末在蒙扎举行的意大利大奖赛中，梅赛德斯由基米·安东内利和乔治·拉塞尔包揽前二。此后车手们将面对这条位于西班牙首都、全长5.4公里、共22个弯的全新半街道赛道，踏入未知领域。
在马德里赛道比赛周末前，蒙托亚在F1 TV的Weekend Warm-Up节目中分享了他完成赛道步行后的兴奋之情。
“我今天早上走了一圈，几周前还开过一辆公路车。我已经看过它几次了，”这位哥伦比亚人解释道。“难以置信。说实话，我经常进行赛道步行，因为我的孩子参加F2比赛，所以我们每场比赛都会走赛道，但这是我第一次想，‘哦，我想开这条赛道。’”
“在我们今年去过的所有赛道中，这是我第一次想，‘这将会是难以置信的。’我认为赛道图无法体现它的精髓，因为存在海拔变化和盲区。”
“很多弯道是旧式风格，内外都有护墙，而且都是盲弯。你在转弯，而离弯心越近的人就是离墙越近的人，我认为这带来了很多很酷的东西，因为当你把弯心打开时，任何人都能做到。”
“任何人都可以走宽线，这里一点那里一点，但如果你把护墙放在那里，你就必须做到完美。我认为这就是你需要带来的投入程度。太不可思议了。”
detailEn: Juan Pablo Montoya says Madring is first 2026 F1 track he wants to drive
Juan Pablo Montoya has praised the Madring circuit, saying its challenging layout have made him want to get back behind the wheel
Former Formula 1 driver Juan Pablo Montoya has praised the brand-new Madring circuit, revealing that it is the first track of the 2026 season that has made him want to get back behind the wheel.

After the Italian Grand Prix at Monza last weekend, which resulted in a Mercedes 1-2 finish with Kimi Antonelli and George Russell, the drivers now face a step into the unknown at the new 5.4km, 22-turn layout semi-street circuit in the Spanish capital.
Speaking on F1 TV's Weekend Warm-Up show ahead of the race weekend at Madring, Montoya shared his excitement after completing a track walk.

"I walked it this morning, and I've been in a road car a couple of weeks ago. I've seen it a few times," the Colombian explained. "Unbelievable. Honestly, I do a lot of track walks because my kid races in Formula 2, so we do track walks every race, and this was the first time I went, 'Oo, I would like to drive this.'
"Out of all the tracks we've been to this year, it's the first time I've gone, 'This would be unbelievable.' I don't think the track map does it justice because of the elevation and the blindness.

"A lot of the corners are old-style, with barriers inside and out, and they're blind corners. You're turning, and the guy who gets closer to the apex is the guy who is closest to the wall, and I think that brings a lot of cool things because when you open the apexes, anybody can do it.

"Anybody can run a wide line, a little here, a little there, but if you put a barrier on it, you've got to be perfect. And I think that is just the level of commitment you need to bring. It's incredible."

他指出许多弯道是旧式风格，内外都有护墙，且是盲弯，需要极高的投入度。

items.summaryZh: 勒克莱尔因上周末意大利大奖赛在帕拉波利卡弯出口撞墙，无法在西班牙大奖赛使用法拉利最新的ADUO2引擎规格，只能使用ADUO1引擎，而汉密尔顿可正常使用ADUO2。

items.originalTitle: 勒克莱尔西班牙大奖赛无缘法拉利最新引擎规格
items.summaryEn: Charles Leclerc will not be able to use Ferrari's latest ADUO2 engine specification at the Spanish Grand Prix due to his crash at the exit of the Parabolica in last weekend's Italian Grand Prix, and will instead use an ADUO1 engine, while Lewis Hamilton can use the ADUO2 as normal.
detailZh: 为什么查尔斯·勒克莱尔在西班牙大奖赛不使用最新的ADUO2引擎
法拉利在蒙扎引入了新的引擎规格，但勒克莱尔赛车上的动力单元在意大利大奖赛撞车后仍在接受检查
查尔斯·勒克莱尔仍能感受到上周末意大利大奖赛在帕拉波利卡弯出口撞墙的痛楚，而这次撞车的结果是，他将无法在西班牙大奖赛期间使用法拉利最新的F1引擎规格。
据了解，法拉利工程师认为配备FIA允许的第二套修改方案的067/6单元状态良好，但他们不想冒险在马德里环道运行它。
原因非常简单：F1规则禁止运行无法对其所有众多认证部件进行作业的引擎。在外部结构检查中未发现裂纹或断裂，但计划进行更彻底的X射线检查，以确定是否存在可能未被发现的微小损伤区域。
因此，不在西班牙首都冒险使用ADUO2引擎的决定是合乎逻辑的：马德里环道是新的，车手需要尽可能多地行驶，而工程师需要收集数据，以最终确定一个必须做出重大妥协的调校，以结合非常慢的路段和快速路段的需求。
顺便提一下，这座伊比利亚首都位于海拔667米处，与奥地利红牛环的海拔相似。因此，作为ADUO2套件一部分安装的更大的涡轮压缩机本可在略微稀薄的空气中提供性能提升。
勒克莱尔的赛车在蒙扎撞车中严重受损，引擎结构仍在接受彻底检查
周五练习中动力单元的任何小问题都可能危及大奖赛的准备工作，因此决定将受观察引擎的回归推迟到巴库的FP1。
因此，勒克莱尔将使用ADUO1引擎，而赛道工作人员将能够评估该单元与ADUO2之间的实际性能差异，刘易斯·汉密尔顿将能够正常使用ADUO2。
没有人谈论这件事，尤其是在蒙扎的尴尬之后，但车队内部有在马德里取得好成绩的雄心，因此仍有几个选项需要考虑。
这条赛道可能适合SF-26的特性：需要中高水平的空气动力学下压力，而沥青预计不会提供特别高的抓地力，这可能有利于那些在弯道出口具有出色牵引力的赛车。
下压力应该比效率更重要（我们可能会看到活动翼作动器上的额外襟翼再次出现），而法拉利受梅赛德斯V6动力不足的影响应该较小，因为有22个弯角，充电机会比蒙扎多得多。
汉密尔顿和勒克莱尔需要高度专注于单圈速度，因为在这条几乎不可能超车的赛道上，强劲的排位赛表现可能具有决定性。然而，如果事情没有按计划进行，摩纳哥人启用第二台ADUO2引擎（在池中可用）也并非不可能，这将导致他因引入本赛季第五台动力单元而受到首次处罚，但确保他有足够的储备以在没有进一步意外的情况下完成锦标赛。
detailEn: Why Charles Leclerc isn't using latest ADUO2 engine in the Spanish GP
Ferrari introduced a new engine specification in Monza, but the power unit in Leclerc's car is still undergoing checks following his crash at the Italian GP

Charles Leclerc is still feeling the pain of smiting the wall at the exit of the Parabolica in last weekend's Italian Grand Prix, and the result of the crash is that he will not be able to use Ferrari's latest Formula 1 engine spec during the Spanish GP.

It's understood Ferrari engineers deemed the 067/6 unit, fitted with the second package of modifications permitted by the FIA, to be sound, but they did not want to take the risk of running it at the Madring.

The reason is very simple: F1 regulations prohibit running an engine that cannot be worked on in all of its many homologated components. No cracks or breakages were found during the external structural checks, but the intention is to carry out more thorough X-ray examinations to determine whether there are any small areas of damage that may have gone undetected.

The decision not to risk the ADUO2 engine in the Spanish capital is therefore a logical one: the Madring circuit is new and the drivers need to run for as long as possible, while the engineers need to gather data in order to finalise a setup that will have to be a significant compromise to combine the demands of very slow sections with those of the fast ones.

The Iberian capital, incidentally, is located 667 metres above sea level, an altitude similar to that of the Red Bull Ring in Austria. So the more substantial turbo compressor fitted as part of the ADUO2 package could have provided a performance gain in the slightly thinner air.
Leclerc's car was badly damaged by Monza crash and the engine's structure is still being thoroughly checked

Any small issues with the power unit during Friday practice could have risked compromising the preparation for the GP, hence the decision to postpone the return of the engine under observation until FP1 in Baku.

Leclerc, therefore, will have an ADUO1 engine at his disposal, while the trackside staff will be able to assess the actual performance difference between this unit and ADUO2, which Lewis Hamilton will be able to use as normal.
No one is talking about it, especially after the embarrassment at Monza, but within the Scuderia there is an ambition to perform well in Madrid, so there are still several options to consider.

The track could suit the characteristics of the SF-26: a medium-to-high level of aerodynamic downforce is required, and the asphalt is not expected to provide a particularly high level of grip, which could favour those with excellent traction on corner exit.

Downforce should matter more than efficiency (we may see the additional flaps on the actuators of the movable wings reappear), and the Ferrari should be less affected by the power deficit to the Mercedes V6 because there are 22 corners and the opportunities to recharge the battery are considerably greater than at Monza.

Hamilton and Leclerc will need to focus heavily on single-lap pace, because a strong qualifying performance on a circuit where overtaking will be almost impossible could prove decisive. If things do not go according to plan, however, it would not be out of the question for the Monegasque to put a second engine into service with ADUO2 (available in the pool), taking his first penalty for introducing a fifth power unit of the season, but ensuring that he has enough of a reserve to finish the championship without any further surprises.

detailZh: 塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯在马德里第一次自由练习中违规，凯迪拉克被处以两笔罚款
在西班牙大奖赛第一次自由练习期间，塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯被发现超出维修区限速，凯迪拉克因此被罚款两次
由于塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯在马德里西班牙大奖赛的第一次自由练习赛中被发现在维修区超速，凯迪拉克一级方程式车队被处以两笔罚款。
这位墨西哥车手在周末的首个练习赛中两次被发现超过维修区强制规定的80公里/小时限速。
FIA干事因这支美国车队违反FIA F1规则B1.6.3a.i条款，对其处以以下处罚。第一次违规发生在Perez被测得车速86.7公里/小时、超速6.7公里/小时时，被罚款700欧元。第二次违规发生在Perez被记录到以96.7公里/小时行驶、超速16.7公里/小时时，受到更重的1000欧元罚款。
这一切发生在凯迪拉克艰难的首个赛季之际。随着这支车队努力适应这项锦标赛，它面临了严重的可靠性问题。Perez目前在车手积分榜上排名第23位，他的队友Valtieri Bottas排名第22位，两人均为零分。
马德里的第一次自由练习赛也是车手们首次驶上马德里赛道赛道。该场地围绕IFEMA马德里展览中心和附近的Valdebebas区而建，采用半街道赛道布局。
这条赛道融合了紧凑区域和高速直道，还拥有一个名为"La Monumental"的带坡度大弯。
“就我所见，这条赛道本身是一条真正意义上的赛道，”佩雷斯在比赛周开始前对媒体表示。“我还没有亲自上过这条赛道，但从我在模拟器上看到的情况来看，它是一条正儿八经的赛道。
“我得说，它有点吓人。它让我有点想起吉达。很好、很正规的一条赛道，来到这里真的很开心，而且我觉得这里的氛围将会是最棒的之一。”
这位36岁的车手在一练中跑出了第21快的成绩，仅领先于博塔斯。
detailEn: Cadillac hit with two fines after Sergio Perez FP1 infringements in Madrid
Cadillac has been fined twice after Sergio Perez was caught exceeding the pitlane speed limit during FP1 at the Spanish Grand Prix
The Cadillac Formula 1 team has been handed two fines after Sergio Perez was found to be speeding in the pitlane during the first free practice session at the Spanish Grand Prix in Madrid.
The Mexican driver was caught exceeding the mandatory 80km/h pitlane speed limit on two separate occasions during the opening session of the weekend.

The FIA stewards issued the following penalties to the American outfit for breaching Article B1.6.3a.i of the FIA F1 regulations. The first offence resulted in a fine of €700 when Perez was clocked at 86.7km/h, exceeding the limit by 6.7km/h. The second offence resulted in a heavier penalty of €1000 after Perez was recorded travelling at 96.7km/h, exceeding the limit by 16.7km/h.

This comes amid a difficult debut season for Cadillac. As the outfit works to adjust to the championship, it has faced significant reliability issues. Perez currently sits 23rd in the drivers' standings and his team-mate Valtteri Bottas is 22nd, both on zero points.

The first practice session in Madrid also marked the first time the drivers took to the Madring circuit. Built around the IFEMA Madrid exhibition centre and the nearby Valdebebas district, the venue operates a semi-street circuit layout.
The track features a mix of tight zones and high-speed straights as well as the banked, sweeping curve called "La Monumental".

"The track itself is a proper race track, from what I've seen," Perez told the media ahead of the race weekend. "I haven't been on the circuit yet, but from what I've seen on the simulator, it's a proper track.
"It's a bit scary, I'll say. It reminds me a bit of Jeddah. Good, proper track, really happy to be here, and I think the atmosphere here is going to be one of the best."
The 36-year-old put in the 21st fastest time during FP1, only ahead of Bottas.

items.titleZh: 阿斯顿·马丁称兰斯·斯特罗尔在多条F1赛道"不可战胜"
items.summaryZh: 阿斯顿·马丁F1大使佩德罗·德拉罗萨盛赞兰斯·斯特罗尔，称这位加拿大车手可以和队友费尔南多·阿隆索一样快。不过自2023年成为队友以来，斯特罗尔在排位赛和积分上均大幅落后于阿隆索。

items.originalTitle: 阿斯顿·马丁称兰斯·斯特罗尔在多个F1赛道“不可战胜”
items.summaryEn: Aston Martin F1 ambassador Pedro de la Rosa has praised Lance Stroll, claiming the Canadian can be as quick as his team-mate Fernando Alonso. However, since becoming team-mates in 2023, Stroll has been heavily outqualified and outscored by Alonso.
detailZh: 阿斯顿·马丁声称兰斯·斯特罗尔在许多F1赛道上“无可匹敌”
佩德罗·德·拉·罗萨解释斯特罗尔如何与两届世界冠军阿隆索“一样快”
阿斯顿·马丁F1大使佩德罗·德·拉·罗萨对兰斯·斯特罗尔大加赞赏，声称这位加拿大车手可以和他的队友费尔南多·阿隆索“一样快”。
阿隆索和斯特罗尔自2023年起成为队友，在此期间，这位27岁的车手在排位赛中以15比89落后于队友，在积分上也以131分远远落后于阿隆索的335分。
即便随着阿隆索年龄渐长、斯特罗尔积累了更多经验，两人之间的比较结果依然类似：2026赛季，45岁的阿隆索在排位赛中的平均单圈时间仍比斯特罗尔快0.3秒。
然而，当德拉罗萨在Beyond The 发车区播客节目中被问及斯特罗尔时，他对后者大加赞赏。
“兰斯速度极快，”这位前F1车手说。“你知道，我喜欢看数据，因为我是以数据为导向的人。我喜欢看一名车手在哪些地方比另一名车手快。而在很多赛道、很多弯角，兰斯都是无可匹敌的。
“并不是说兰斯在高速弯快、费尔南多在……快之类的。他们两人的实力非常相当。”
斯特罗尔，阿斯顿·马丁车队；阿隆索，阿斯顿·马丁车队
“Lance在各种类型的弯道中都极快。问题只是他有时在排位赛中出一些失误或一些小状况，而如果你没能在排位中排到前面，这就会影响整个周末。这就是他欠缺的地方，你知道，就是有时候没能在排位赛里把所有东西都发挥出来。
“但有时候他在排位赛中做到了，并且排位成绩超过了Fernando，这可是……我的意思是，我们说的是阿隆索啊，你知道的。
“而在比赛中，他的比赛节奏也同样令人印象深刻。他非常擅长管理轮胎。”
但这里有一个“如果”，而且并非无关紧要。De la Rosa 确实澄清说，Stroll 需要赛车达到预期表现，才能与他的队友相匹敌。
“我认为 Lance 是一位被严重低估的车手，”他继续说道。“当我们改进赛车并让它对车手更友好一点时——我必须说，出于很多原因，现在这是一辆非常难开的赛车，不仅是赛车和底盘，还有引擎方面，我们必须在可操控性上做出改进——只要赛车运转正常，他就能和 Fernando 一样快。这一点毫无疑问。”
detailEn: Aston Martin claims Lance Stroll is “unbeatable” at many F1 tracks
Pedro de la Rosa explains how Stroll is “as quick” as two-time world champion Alonso
Aston Martin Formula 1 ambassador Pedro de la Rosa has heaped praise on Lance Stroll, claiming the Canadian can be “as quick” as his team-mate Fernando Alonso.
Alonso and Stroll have been team-mates since 2023, and over that period, the 27-year-old has been outqualified 89-15 and outscored 335 points to 131.
Even as Alonso has grown older and Stroll has gained even more experience, the comparison between them has remained similar, with the 45-year-old three tenths faster in qualifying on average in 2026.
Yet, when asked about Stroll in the Beyond The Grid podcast, de la Rosa was laudatory.

“Lance is super fast,” the former F1 driver said. “You know, I love to watch data because I'm data-driven. And I like to see where one driver is faster than the other. And Lance, in many circuits, in many corners, is unbeatable.
“It's not like you can say Lance is fast in high-speed, Fernando in... They're both very evenly matched.
Lance Stroll, Aston Martin Racing, Fernando Alonso, Aston Martin Racing

“Lance is extremely quick in all types of corners. It's just that sometimes he's had some mistakes in qualifying or little things that then eventually if you don't qualify up there, it just compromises the whole weekend. That's where he's missing, you know, it's just sometimes putting everything together in quali.
“But sometimes he gets it in quali and he outqualifies Fernando, which is like... I mean, we're talking about Fernando Alonso, you know.
“And in races, his race pace is impressive as well. He's very good managing tyres.”
But there’s an ‘if’, and not an insignificant one. De la Rosa does clarify that Stroll requires the car to perform as expected in order to match his team-mate.

“I think Lance is a very underrated driver,” he continued. “When we improve the car and make it a bit more driver-friendly – I must say it's a very difficult car right now for many reasons, not only car, chassis, but also on the engine, we have to make improvements on driveability – whenever the car is driving properly, he's as quick as Fernando. There's no question about that.”

items.summaryZh: 前F1车手、F1 TV评论员乔里恩·帕尔默认为，法拉利已错过将刘易斯·汉密尔顿的争冠作为优先事项的时机，马拉内罗车队已让自己的争冠希望溜走。

items.summaryEn: Former F1 driver and F1 TV pundit Jolyon Palmer believes Ferrari has missed its window to prioritise Lewis Hamilton's championship bid, arguing the Maranello team has already let its title hopes slip away.
detailZh: 前F1车手乔利恩·帕尔默（Jolyon Palmer）表示，法拉利在F1冠军争夺战中让刘易斯·汉密尔顿优先的时机已经太迟
乔利恩·帕尔默认为，法拉利等待太久才在F1冠军争夺战中让刘易斯·汉密尔顿优先
前F1车手兼F1电视评论员乔利恩·帕尔默认为，法拉利已经错过了支持刘易斯·汉密尔顿争夺总冠军的窗口期，他认为这家马拉内罗车队已经让夺冠希望悄然溜走。
这支由弗雷德·瓦塞尔（Fred Vasseur）领衔的车队在遭遇蒙扎主场的灾难性比赛后参加了西班牙大奖赛。汉密尔顿和队友夏尔·勒克莱尔分别以第三和第四位发车，在首圈1号弯发生碰撞，随后这位摩纳哥车手在第二圈撞车退赛。
汉密尔顿目前在车手积分榜上以191分排名第三，落后总冠军领跑者安东内利 76分，而勒克莱尔以155分排名第五。
一段时间以来，一直有人呼吁法拉利支持一名一号车手，但帕尔默声称，现在在总冠军争夺战中已经太迟了。
“嗯，我觉得已经太迟了，”帕尔默在F1 TV的《Weekend Warm-Up》节目中被问到是否是时候让法拉利在冠军争夺中支持汉密尔顿时说道。
“机会已经错过了。我觉得他们正在远离总冠军的争夺。他们不会成功的。我认为他们的速度不够快。”
勒克莱尔，法拉利，汉密尔顿，法拉利
“车手们太专注于互相击败了，Lewis刚才还在说他们需要开始合作。现在是第14站。回想中国站，他们互相碰撞，还有一点接触。在争夺领奖台时他们完全是在朝对方猛冲，而梅赛德斯却趁机溜走了。”
“你会想，好吧，他们那天没有速度击败梅赛德斯，看他们较量还挺有趣，他们确实互相拼得很凶。整个赛季都是如此，但我想不出有哪一次他们真正进行过合作。”
“想想Lewis在巴塞罗那夺冠时Charles根本不具备争夺条件，而Charles在银石夺冠时Lewis起跑抢跳，也谈不上真正有争夺。”
"所以当他们拥有一辆竞争力较差的赛车时，我确实觉得他们很可能不得不优先照顾某一位车手，或者至少确保他们在任何一场比赛中都能协同作战。
"在蒙扎从第三和第四位发车，身后有一辆梅赛德斯，两辆迈凯伦也在后面，马克斯·维斯塔潘同样在后方，你会想，好吧，你们其实有一个绝佳的机会在主场迎战对手。结果他们立刻就开始互相较劲了。"
detailEn: Ferrari "too late" to prioritise Lewis Hamilton in F1 title fight, says Jolyon Palmer
Jolyon Palmer believes Ferrari has waited too long to prioritise Lewis Hamilton in the Formula 1 title fight

Former Formula 1 driver and F1 TV pundit Jolyon Palmer believes Ferrari has missed its window to prioritise Lewis Hamilton's championship bid, arguing that the Maranello outfit has already allowed its title hopes to slip away.

The Fred Vasseur-led team arrived at the Spanish Grand Prix on the back of a disastrous home race at Monza. Starting third and fourth, Hamilton and team-mate Charles Leclerc clashed at Turn 1 on the opening lap before the Monegasque driver crashed out on the second lap.
Hamilton currently sits third in the drivers' standings with 191 points, 76 points behind championship leader Kimi Antonelli, while Leclerc is fifth with 155 points.
There have been calls for Ferrari to back a number one driver for some time, but Palmer claims it is now too late in the championship fight.
"Well, I feel like it's too late," Palmer said during the F1 TV Weekend Warm-Up show when asked if it is time for Ferrari to back Hamilton in the title fight.
"The ship has sailed. I feel like they're drifting away from championship contention. They're not going to make it. I don't think they're quick enough.
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari

"And the drivers are so focused on beating each other that Lewis is talking there about how they need to start working together. We're on round 14. I think back to China and they were knocking into each other, and there was a little bit of contact. They were absolutely swinging for each other for a podium while the Mercedes escaped.

"You thought, OK, they don't have the pace to beat Mercedes on that day and it was fun to watch, and they do race each other really hard. They have done all season, but I can't think of a single time where they've actually worked together.
"Think of Lewis's win and Charles wasn't in contention in Barcelona, and Charles's win and Lewis had jumped the start and wasn't really in contention at Silverstone.
"So when they have an inferior car, I do feel like they had to probably prioritise a driver, if not at least make sure that they're working together in any given race.

"Starting third and fourth at Monza with one Mercedes at the back, both McLarens behind them, Max Verstappen behind as well, you're thinking, OK, you've actually got a great chance to take the fight on your home turf. And they immediately started having a go with each other."

items.titleZh: F1首次在马德林赛道进行练习赛：拉塞尔领先安东内利
items.summaryZh: 在2026年西班牙大奖赛首次练习赛中，梅赛德斯车手乔治·拉塞尔领先队友基米·安东内利，这是F1历史上首次在马德里近郊的新街道赛道马德林（马德里赛道）进行练习。
items.originalTitle: F1首次在马德林赛道进行练习赛：拉塞尔领先安东内利
items.summaryEn: Mercedes' George Russell led his team-mate Kimi Antonelli in the first ever F1 practice session at the new Madring street circuit near Madrid, during FP1 for the 2026 Spanish Grand Prix.
detailZh: 在马德里赛道赛道举行的2026年西班牙大奖赛第一次自由练习赛中，梅赛德斯车队的拉塞尔领先队友安东内利，本次练习基本没有事故。
Russell做出了1分34.077秒的标杆成绩，Antonelli落后0.286秒。两人在60分钟练习赛接近尾声时用软胎做出了各自的最快圈速——这是F1首次在马德里市郊新街道赛道进行练习。
除了几次因打滑和冲出赛道而出示的黄旗外，练习赛顺利进行，没有出现红旗。
众多车手的圈速被删除，5号弯有12次违规，17号弯有9次。仅跑了几圈后，中性胎和软胎上就出现了颗粒化现象，而造型壮观的12号倾斜弯（La Monumental）对轮胎施加了相当大的负荷。
法拉利车队的勒克莱尔使用软胎排名第三，落后最快圈速0.459秒，而他的队友汉密尔顿在一次软胎飞驰圈中在17号弯锁死轮胎，因此他在本次练习赛中的最快圈速是使用中性胎做出的1分34.620秒。
据了解，Leclerc在蒙扎用升级版法拉利引擎发生撞车退赛后，现在使用的是赞德沃特站时旧规格的法拉利动力单元。
诺里斯在第六位，比维斯塔潘慢十分之二秒，这位迈凯伦车手的最快成绩出现在软胎练习段的早期，他的队友皮亚斯特里排名第八，又慢了十分之二秒。
在两辆迈凯伦之间的是比赛 Bull车队的Arvid Lindblad，比最快圈速慢了大约一秒。
奥迪车队的尼克·霍肯伯格落后1.452秒排名第九，红牛车队的替补车手利亚姆·劳森位列前十的最后一名。
全场成绩相差4.741秒，凯迪拉克垫底——瓦尔特利·博塔斯落后队友塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯0.7秒，而佩雷斯则比次慢车队慢了半秒。
阿斯顿·马丁的本土车手费尔南多·阿隆索落后2.396秒排名第15，但比队友兰斯·斯特罗尔快了将近0.8秒，后者排名第19。
卡洛斯·塞恩斯在他的主场周末以落后2.793秒的第17名开启征程，而威廉姆斯队友亚历山大·阿尔本慢了0.7秒，排名第20，仅排在两辆凯迪拉克之前。
detailEn: Mercedes' George Russell led his team-mate Kimi Antonelli in a largely incident-free FP1 session for the 2026 Spanish Grand Prix at the Madring.

Russell set the benchmark of 1m34.077s with Antonelli 0.286s off the pace. The pair set their respective fastest laps on soft tyres towards the end of the 60-minute session - the first for F1 at the new street circuit on the outskirts of Spanish capital Madrid.
Barring a few yellow flags for spins and off-track excursions, the session was trouble-free with no red flags waved.

Numerous drivers had their times deleted with 12 violations at Turn 5 and nine at Turn 17. Graining was also visible on the medium and soft tyres after just a handful of laps, with the spectacular-looking banked Turn 12 (La Monumental) putting considerable load through them.

Ferrari's Charles Leclerc was third on soft tyres, 0.459s off the pace, while team-mate Lewis Hamilton locked up at Turn 17 on a soft-tyred flying lap, so his fastest lap of the session was a 1m34.620s set on mediums.
Leclerc is believed to be using the older-spec Ferrari power unit from Zandvoort after crashing out at Monza with the upgraded Ferrari engine.
Lando Norris was two tenths off Max Verstappen in sixth, with the McLaren driver’s fastest time coming early into a soft-tyre stint, his team-mate Oscar Piastri another two tenths off in eighth.
Between the McLarens was Racing Bulls's Arvid Lindblad, around a second off the pace.
Audi's Nico Hulkenberg was 1.452s off in ninth, and Red Bull's stand-in Liam Lawson rounded out the top 10.
The field was split by 4.741s with Cadillac rounding out the standings - Valtteri Bottas seven-tenths behind team-mate Sergio Perez, who in turn was half a second back from the next-slowest team.
Aston Martin's home driver Fernando Alonso was 2.396s off the pace in 15th but almost eight tenths faster than team-mate Lance Stroll, 19th.
Carlos Sainz began his home weekend in 17th, 2.793s off the pace, while Williams team-mate Alex Albon was seven tenths slower and 20th ahead of only the Cadillacs.

梅赛德斯在马德里的首次练习赛中包揽前二，但法拉利尚未展现其实力
梅赛德斯的乔治·拉塞尔在全新马德里赛道赛道举行的首个F1练习赛——西班牙大奖赛第一次自由练习中做出最快圈速。
22辆赛车中有20辆在练习赛开始后的头100秒内驶上了这条全新赛道，尼科·霍肯伯格和弗兰科·科拉平托则稍晚一些才出场。
最初几个飞行圈略显试探性，大多数车手的圈速在1分42秒到1分45秒之间，但汉密尔顿、维斯塔潘和诺里斯一上来就跑出了1分39秒。
在练习赛的前半段，圈速不断被刷新，仅八分钟内Hamilton就跑到了1分36.066秒。这位法拉利车手一直比任何人都快，先后把标杆提升到1分35.563秒和1分34.803秒。队友勒克莱尔确实快了0.120秒，但Hamilton以1分34.620秒险些又夺回头名位置。
除了博托莱托（使用硬胎）之外，所有车手都在上半节使用中性胎，随后软胎开始投入使用。
然而，安东内利和Russell在软胎上的首轮尝试——各跑了两圈——分别比Hamilton的中性胎基准慢了0.063秒和0.109秒。
拉塞尔的第三次尝试做出1分34.145秒，足以升至最快，随后他又将成绩提升至1分34.077秒。安东内利做出1分34.363秒，使梅赛德斯包揽前二。
与此同时，勒克莱尔和汉密尔顿都在17号弯冲出赛道。这位摩纳哥车手仅以微弱优势刷新了自己的个人最好成绩，而他的队友则成为唯一没有用软胎做出最快圈的車手——与角田裕毅一样，后者因小红牛赛车转向助力系统故障，在距离结束还有25分钟时退出了本节练习。
维斯塔潘排名第五，领先于诺里斯、阿维德·林德布拉德——他甩开了中游集团的其余车手——以及奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里。
霍肯伯格、利亚姆·劳森、博托莱托、皮埃尔·加斯利、埃斯特班·奥孔和科拉平托紧随其后，成绩在1分35.5秒至1分35.9秒之间。
主场作战的英雄费尔南多·阿隆索（阿隆索）拿到了令人鼓舞的第15名——以阿斯顿·马丁目前的标准来看——排在一辆哈斯、两辆威廉姆斯、两辆凯迪拉克以及队友兰斯·斯特罗尔（斯特罗尔）之前。
本次练习赛的主要事故发生在林德布拉德（Lindblad）做飞驰圈时，在La Monumental弯道遇到了安东内利（Antonelli）和汉密尔顿（Hamilton）行驶缓慢的梅赛德斯和法拉利。
“又是这两个家伙，哥们！”这位新秀在车队无线电里怒吼。“我都不知道他们在干什么，他们就是蠢，正好在高速弯里！这真的非常危险，这已经是第二次了。”
随后汉密尔顿又卷入了更多阻挡事故，受害的是队友勒克莱尔（Leclerc）和霍肯伯格（Hulkenberg）。卡洛斯·塞恩斯（塞恩斯）也对这位七届世界冠军在La Monumental让他通过的方式表示了抱怨。
detailEn: F1 Spanish GP: George Russell tops FP1 as Lewis Hamilton impedes several drivers
Mercedes achieved a 1-2 in the opening practice session in Madrid, but Ferrari hasn’t shown its potential yet
Mercedes’ George Russell was fastest in the first-ever Formula 1 session at the brand-new Madring track – Free Practice 1 for the Spanish Grand Prix.
Twenty out of 22 cars took to the brand-new track within the first 100 seconds of the session, with Nico Hulkenberg and Franco Colapinto emerging some time later.
The very first flying laps were somewhat tentative with most drivers in the 1m42s-1m45s bracket, but Lewis Hamilton, Max Verstappen and Lando Norris lapped in 1m39s straight away.

Lap times kept tumbling in the opening part of the session, with Hamilton down to a 1m36.066s within just eight minutes. Consistently faster than anyone, the Ferrari driver successively improved the benchmark to 1m35.563s and 1m34.803s. Team-mate Charles Leclerc did go 0.120s quicker, but Hamilton narrowly snatched the top spot back in 1m34.620s.
After all drivers but Gabriel Bortoleto (on hards) spent the first half of the session on medium tyres, softs were brought into action.
However, Kimi Antonelli’s and Russell’s opening efforts – two each – on that compound fell 0.063s and 0.109s short of Hamilton’s medium-tyre reference.
Russell’s third attempt, a 1m34.145s was good enough to go fastest, and he subsequently upgraded it to a 1m34.077s. Antonelli, in 1m34.363s, made it a Mercedes 1-2.

Meanwhile, both Leclerc and Hamilton went wide at Turn 17. The Monegasque only narrowly improved on his personal best, while his team-mate ended up as the only driver not to set his quickest lap on soft rubber – alongside Yuki Tsunoda, who was ruled out of the session with 25 minutes remaining by a power steering issue on his Racing Bulls.
Verstappen was fifth ahead of Norris, Arvid Lindblad – who cleared the remainder of the midfield group – and Oscar Piastri.
Hulkenberg, Liam Lawson, Bortoleto, Pierre Gasly, Esteban Ocon and Colapinto followed in a 1m35.5s-1m35.9s bracket.
Home hero Fernando Alonso was an encouraging 15th – by Aston Martin’s current standards – ahead of one Haas, both Williams, both Cadillacs and team-mate Lance Stroll.
The main incident of the session occurred when Lindblad, on a flying lap, came across the slow Mercedes and Ferrari of Antonelli and Hamilton in La Monumental.

“These same two guys, man!” the rookie ranted over team radio. “Like, I don’t know what they’re doing, they’re just stupid, right in the fast corner! It’s actually very dangerous, it’s been twice now.”

Hamilton was then involved in further impeding incidents at team-mate Leclerc’s and Hulkenberg’s expense. Carlos Sainz also complained about the way the seven-time world champion let him by in La Monumental.

detailZh: 詹姆斯·欣奇克利夫警告称，弗雷德·瓦塞尔在法拉利车队指令问题上面临着"巨大的"压力
詹姆斯·欣奇克利夫认为，法拉利车队领队弗雷德·瓦塞尔正承受着越来越大的压力，需要建立明确的车内交锋规则
据前印地车系列赛车手、F1电视评论员詹姆斯·欣奇克利夫表示，法拉利车队领队弗雷德·瓦塞尔正面临着"巨大的"压力，需要在刘易斯·汉密尔顿和夏尔·勒克莱尔之间建立明确的车队指令规则。
要求明确车队指令的呼声，源自这支马拉内罗车队最近几站比赛的艰难经历。在荷兰大奖赛上，汉密尔顿和勒克莱尔分别以第四和第五名完赛，但这位七届世界冠军在整场比赛中不断通过车队无线电愤怒抱怨缺乏车队指令；而在意大利大奖赛上，这一议题再度浮现，两位车手在第一圈就发生了冲突。
在F1电视（F1 TV）的《周末热身》（Weekend Warm-Up）节目中，辛奇克利夫被问及法拉利车队领队所承受的压力，因为要求明确车队指令的呼声日益高涨。
“就目前而言，压力非常大，因为事情已经发展到这个地步了，”辛奇克利夫解释道，“这是他们合作第二年的第十四站比赛，我们还在讨论这类问题。交战规则到底是什么？迈凯伦有非常明确的规则，梅赛德斯也有非常明确的规则。”
“无论是法拉利一直以来都缺失这样的规则，还是只是最近没有去研究这个问题，显然他们在不久的将来必须就此进行一次讨论。”
夏尔·勒克莱尔，法拉利；刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利
在接受Motorsport.com的独家专访时，瓦塞尔承认，在意大利大奖赛之后，车队确实需要与汉密尔顿和勒克莱尔进行一些讨论，但他否认了车队内部存在危机的说法。
这位法国人还解释说，车队内部有相应的行为准则，但他补充道：“你不能指望合同涵盖你在赛道上可能遇到的所有情况，因为那样一来，一切都将不可避免地沦为对条款的解读问题。”

detailEn: James Hinchcliffe warns Fred Vasseur faces "tremendous" pressure over Ferrari team orders
James Hinchcliffe believes Ferrari team principal Fred Vasseur is under mounting pressure to establish clear rules of engagement

Ferrari team principal Fred Vasseur is facing a "tremendous amount" of pressure to establish clear rules of engagement between Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc, according to former IndyCar Series driver and F1 TV pundit James Hinchcliffe.

The calls for clear team orders come after a couple of difficult races for the Maranello outfit. While Hamilton and Leclerc finished fourth and fifth at the Dutch Grand Prix, the seven-time champion fumed over the team radio throughout the race about a lack of team orders, and the issue came up again at the Italian Grand Prix when both drivers clashed on the opening lap.
Speaking on F1 TV's Weekend Warm-Up show, Hinchcliffe was asked about the pressure on the Ferrari team chief as calls for clear team orders have intensified.

"A tremendous amount at this point just because it has got to this stage," Hinchcliffe explained. "We're round 14 of their second year working together and we're still having these sorts of questions. What are the rules of engagement? There are very clear rules at McLaren and there are very clear rules at Mercedes.
"Whether it's always been missing from Ferrari or just recently hasn't been something they've looked into, it's clearly something that they have to have a discussion about in the near future."
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari

During an exclusive interview with Motorsport.com, Vasseur admitted that there were discussions to be had with Hamilton and Leclerc following the Italian Grand Prix, but dismissed claims that there is an internal crisis at the team.

The Frenchman also explained that there are rules of engagement in place, but added that "you can’t expect contracts to cover every possible scenario you might encounter on track, because inevitably everything would become a matter of interpretation."
The focus now shifts to the upcoming Spanish Grand Prix at the Madring circuit, which will take place on Sunday 13 September.

items.summaryEn: FIA President Mohammed Ben Sulayem says he is open to Formula 1 adding a 12th team, but any candidate must join on the championship's terms.
detailZh: 国际汽联主席穆罕默德·本·苏拉耶姆对F1增加第12支车队持开放态度，但表示任何候选者都必须按照锦标赛的条件加入。
本·苏拉耶姆曾推动国际汽联在2023年初启动意向表达程序，以接纳第11支车队加入发车格，尽管许多现有车队反对扩大规模。
尽管持续遭到抵制，凯迪拉克成为该程序中唯一成功的候选者，于2026年初成为F1的第11支车队。
此后，有传言称比亚迪等中国制造商正在权衡是否自行发起参赛。
比亚迪不想收购现有车队（例如奥迪收购索伯），因此任何全新车队都需要国际汽联启动新的意向表达程序。
在马德里举行的新经济论坛上发言时，本·苏拉耶姆为比亚迪这样的制造商重启该程序打开了大门。
“国际汽联可以为第12支车队开放。但是，‘我们需要一支车队吗，主席先生？’不，我们不需要一支车队，我们需要的是那支车队，”本·苏拉耶姆说。
“所以现在我们在美国有三场比赛，我们有一个制造商，我们有哈斯，但我们需要一个OEM[原始设备制造商]。
“所以我说，甚至推广方[F1管理公司]也同意我们需要那支车队，而且那支车队必须来自中国。”
吸引制造商是制定F1 2026年技术规则过程中的关键目标，可持续燃料、动力单元部分电气化以及取消MGU-H都是说服奥迪加入的关键——本田也逆转了其退出F1的决定。
但本·苏拉耶姆明确表示，任何新制造商未来都将按照国际汽联/F1的条件加入。
“我与他们[其他制造商]开过会，他们来了，说我们需要加入。其中一个是比亚迪，一个是吉利。我们说，‘好的，如果你们要来，我们就开放意向表达’。
“但规则不会只受中国[制造商]影响。我们不能这样做。规则必须保持永久性，必须保持稳定性。
“我知道中国在电气化方面领先，但这是实现我们电气化目标的唯一途径吗？我们追求什么？我们追求清洁的环境和清洁的空气。所以有很多方法可以实现。
“现在我们未来对WRC[世界拉力锦标赛]开放氢能、混合动力、电气化，以及可持续燃料。
“所以在我开会时，我非常非常清楚。你们为什么不先收购一支车队——那是对比亚迪说的；我为什么要保密呢？——他们说，‘不，我们想要自己的车队’。
“[本·苏拉耶姆说]‘好的。那么请带着一个我们能看出会奏效的认真报价回来’。这就是我们的规则。我对他们的规则非常清楚。
“我们在中国有一场比赛。规模巨大。制造商，我们也有，我们曾有一位中国车手[周冠宇，2022-24年效力于索伯]，中国的技术就在那里。
“但这必须按照我们的条件和规则，这对每个人都是公平的。因为这也是国际汽联的责任。”
F1目前计划从2031年起转向V8引擎，这对任何新制造商来说都是一个合理的切入点。
detailEn: FIA president Mohammed Ben Sulayem is open to Formula 1 adding a 12th team to the grid, but says any candidate will have to join on the championship's terms.
Ben Sulayem prompted the FIA to launch an expression of interest process in early 2023 for an 11th team to join the grid, despite resistance from many of the existing teams to expand the field.
Cadillac emerged as the sole successful candidate from that process despite continued resistance, becoming F1's 11th team at the start of 2026.
Since then, there's been talk of a Chinese manufacturer such as BYD weighing up whether to launch an entry of its own.
BYD doesn't want to acquire an existing team (as Audi did with Sauber, for example), so any brand-new team would need the FIA to launch a new expression of interest process.
And, speaking at the New Economy Forum in Madrid, Ben Sulayem opened the door to restarting that process for a manufacturer like BYD.
"The FIA can open for a 12th team. But, 'Do we need a team, Mr President?' No, we don't need a team, we need the team," Ben Sulayem said.
"So now we have three races in America and the United States, and we have a manufacturer, we have Haas, but we needed an OEM [manufacturer].
"So I said, and even the promoter, [Formula One Management], agrees that we need the team, and the team has to come from China."

Attracting manufacturers was a key aim of the process of forming F1's 2026 regulations, with sustainable fuel, partial electrification of the power unit and then the removal of the MGU-H all crucial to convincing Audi to join - with Honda also reversing its F1 withdrawal.
But Ben Sulayem made it clear that any new manufacturer would be joining on the terms of the FIA/F1 in future.

"I had meetings with them [other manufacturers], and they came and they said, we need to be in. And one of them was BYD, and one was Geely. And we said, 'OK, we will open the expression of interest if you are coming'.
"But the regulations is not going to be affected only by Chinese [manufacturers]. We cannot do this. The regulations have to stay permanent, and it has to [keep] stability in it.

"I know the Chinese are leading in electrification, but is the only way to reach our target in electrification? What are we after? We are after a clean environment and clean air. So there are so many ways to reach it.
"Now we are opening to hydrogen, hybrid, electrification for the WRC [World Rally Championship] in the future, and sustainable fuel.
"So when I had my meetings, I was very, very clear. Why don't you take a team to start with - that was with BYD; why should I be secret about it? - and they said, 'No, we want a team ourselves'.
"[Ben Sulayem said] 'Fine. Then come back with a serious offer that we can see that it's going to work'. And this is our regulations. I was very clear with them about the regulation.
"We have a race in China. It's huge. The manufacturers, we have also, we had a Chinese driver [Zhou Guanyu who raced for Sauber from 2022-24] and the Chinese technology is there.
"But it has to be on our terms and our regulations, which is fair for everyone. Because that's also the responsibility of the FIA."
F1's currently set to move towards having V8 engines from 2031, a logical entry point for any new manufacturer.
